title.en: Hormones of heart, kidney and gut; mechanism of hormone action
title.kn: ಹೃದಯ, ಮೂತ್ರಪಿಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಜಠರಾಂತ್ರ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು; ಹಾರ್ಮೋನು ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ವಿಧಾನ

hook.en: Your heart, kidneys and stomach are not called endocrine glands, yet each of them sends out hormones. And every hormone must find a receptor before it can act.
hook.kn: ಹೃದಯ, ಮೂತ್ರಪಿಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಜಠರವನ್ನು ಅಂತಃಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೂ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನೂ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಗ್ರಾಹಕವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಬೇಕು.

title.en: Hormones of the heart, kidney and gastrointestinal tract

body.en: The atrial wall of the heart secretes a peptide hormone, atrial natriuretic factor (ANF), which decreases blood pressure: when blood pressure rises, ANF causes dilation of the blood vessels. The juxtaglomerular cells of the kidney produce a peptide hormone, erythropoietin, which stimulates erythropoiesis (formation of RBCs). Endocrine cells in different parts of the gastrointestinal tract secrete four major peptide hormones. Gastrin acts on the gastric glands and stimulates secretion of hydrochloric acid and pepsinogen. Secretin acts on the exocrine pancreas and stimulates secretion of water and bicarbonate ions. Cholecystokinin (CCK) acts on both the pancreas and the gall bladder and stimulates secretion of pancreatic enzymes and bile juice. Gastric inhibitory peptide (GIP) inhibits gastric secretion and motility. Several non-endocrine tissues also secrete hormones called growth factors, essential for normal growth and repair of tissues.
body.kn: ಹೃದಯದ ಹೃತ್ಕರ್ಣ ಗೋಡೆ ANF ಸ್ರವಿಸಿ ರಕ್ತದೊತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂತ್ರಪಿಂಡದ JG ಕೋಶಗಳು ಎರಿಥ್ರೋಪೊಯೆಟಿನ್ ಸ್ರವಿಸಿ ಕೆಂಪು ರಕ್ತಕಣ ರಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಜಠರಾಂತ್ರದ ಗ್ಯಾಸ್ಟ್ರಿನ್, ಸೆಕ್ರಿಟಿನ್, CCK ಮತ್ತು GIP ಜೀರ್ಣಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Gastrin: HCl + pepsinogen; secretin: water + HCO3⁻; CCK: pancreatic enzymes + bile; GIP: inhibits gastric secretion and motility

body.en: Hormones produce their effects on target tissues by binding to specific proteins called hormone receptors, located in the target tissues only. Receptors present on the cell membrane are membrane-bound receptors; receptors inside the target cell are intracellular receptors, mostly nuclear receptors present in the nucleus. Binding forms a hormone–receptor complex, and each receptor is specific to one hormone. Hormones that interact with membrane-bound receptors normally do not enter the target cell, but generate second messengers (for example cyclic AMP, IP3 and Ca++), which regulate cellular metabolism. Hormones that interact with intracellular receptors (for example steroid hormones and iodothyronines) mostly regulate gene expression or chromosome function by the interaction of the hormone–receptor complex with the genome. Chemically, hormones are peptide, polypeptide or protein hormones (insulin, glucagon, pituitary and hypothalamic hormones), steroids (cortisol, testosterone, estradiol and progesterone), iodothyronines (thyroid hormones) and amino-acid derivatives (epinephrine).
body.kn: ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಗುರಿ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಂಧಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪೊರೆ-ಬಂಧಿತ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬಂಧಿಸುವ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಕೋಶದೊಳಗೆ ಹೋಗದೆ cAMP, IP3, Ca++ ನಂತಹ ಎರಡನೇ ಸಂದೇಶವಾಹಕಗಳನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ಟೀರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಕೋಶದೊಳಗಿನ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಬಂಧಿಸಿ ಜೀನ್ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Membrane-bound receptor → second messenger (cAMP, IP3, Ca++)
Classes: peptides/proteins, steroids, iodothyronines, amino-acid derivatives

problem.en: Predict the type of receptor each hormone uses and how it acts: (a) insulin, (b) cortisol, (c) thyroxine.

steps.en: (a) Insulin is a peptide hormone: it binds a membrane-bound receptor, does not enter the cell, and acts through second messengers.
(b) Cortisol is a steroid: it enters the cell and binds an intracellular (nuclear) receptor; the complex regulates gene expression.
(c) Thyroxine is an iodothyronine: it also binds an intracellular receptor and regulates gene expression.

answer.en: (a) membrane receptor + second messenger; (b) and (c) intracellular receptor + gene expression

heading.en: Gut hormones in order of digestion

body.en: Gastrin starts (acid), Secretin soothes (bicarbonate), CCK calls the pancreas and gall bladder (enzymes and bile), GIP puts the brakes on the stomach.
